$comment: Skill libraries on the shelf. Add an entry, run `npm run import`, push. Fields: id (short, unique), repo (owner/name on GitHub), path (folder holding one directory per skill), author + copyright (credited on covers and the copyright page), defaultCategory (see src/lib/categories.ts), plugin (how Claude Code installs it: "marketplace.json" to read the repo's own .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, or a fixed { name, marketplace, addMarketplace }), bundleNote (optional, shown with install steps).

sources.author: Jesse Vincent
sources.bundleNote: Superpowers skills are written to work together — using-superpowers teaches the agent when to reach for the rest — so the full set gets the most out of any one of them.

sources.author: Corey Haines
sources.bundleNote: These skills build on shared context: every one of them reads product-marketing first for your product, audience, and positioning, so install product-marketing alongside whichever you pick.
